# Dirty Pawz Press  
[⌂ HOME](/d/dpp-home) · [SALES](/d/dpp-sales) · CATALOG · ADS · [INVENTORY](/d/dpp-inventory) · FINANCE · TRAJECTORY · [DATA HEALTH](/d/dpp-data-health)  
*Operational sales are live from Orders and remain provisional until daily Sales & Traffic and Finances reconciliation.*

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sales,0) AS value FROM mart.business_daily WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE AND marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT COALESCE(orders,0) AS value FROM mart.business_daily WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE AND marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT COALESCE(units,0) AS value FROM mart.business_daily WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE AND marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT COALESCE(sales_t28,0) AS value FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE AND marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';

WITH x AS (SELECT business_date,sales_t28 FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date IN (CURRENT_DATE,CURRENT_DATE-28)) SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(sales_t28) FILTER (WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE-28) > 0 THEN 100.0*(MAX(sales_t28) FILTER (WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE)-MAX(sales_t28) FILTER (WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE-28))/(MAX(sales_t28) FILTER (WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE-28)) ELSE NULL END AS value FROM x;
SELECT COALESCE(sales_t56,0) AS value FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE AND marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM mart.inventory_current WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND fulfillable_quantity=0;
SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time, sales AS value FROM mart.business_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date >= CURRENT_DATE-89 ORDER BY 1;

WITH s AS (SELECT seller_sku, max(asin) asin, sum(sales) sales_t28, sum(units) units_t28 FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date >= CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY seller_sku) SELECT s.seller_sku AS "SKU", COALESCE(k.title,'') AS "Product", round(s.sales_t28,0) AS "T28 Sales", s.units_t28 AS "Units", COALESCE(i.fulfillable_quantity,0) AS "FBA" FROM s LEFT JOIN core.sku k ON k.sku=s.seller_sku LEFT JOIN mart.inventory_current i ON i.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND i.seller_sku=s.seller_sku ORDER BY s.sales_t28 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH v AS (SELECT seller_sku, sum(units)::numeric/28 AS units_day FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date >= CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY seller_sku) SELECT i.seller_sku AS "SKU", COALESCE(k.title,'') AS "Product", i.fulfillable_quantity AS "Available", (i.inbound_working_quantity+i.inbound_shipped_quantity+i.inbound_receiving_quantity) AS "Inbound", CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 THEN round(i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day,1) END AS "Days Cover", CASE WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity=0 AND COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 THEN 'STOCKOUT' WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)=0 THEN 'HOLD' WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day < 14 THEN 'PRODUCE' WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day < 28 THEN 'PLAN' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Action" FROM mart.inventory_current i LEFT JOIN v USING (seller_sku) LEFT JOIN core.sku k ON k.sku=i.seller_sku WHERE i.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.fulfillable_quantity=0 AND COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 AND i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day<14 THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(v.units_day,0)>0 AND i.fulfillable_quantity/v.units_day<28 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, "Days Cover" NULLS LAST;
SELECT job_name AS "Feed", latest_status AS "Status", records_read AS "Read", records_written AS "Written", date_trunc('second',age)::text AS "Age" FROM ops.data_health ORDER BY last_started_at DESC;
